consequence.statement: An optional feature to filter ECS tasks by health status is added; existing configurations without this option continue to work unchanged

original.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds an optional ECS provider feature to filter and keep only healthy ECS tasks.

decision.reason: [ev-a63eb025d087] lists this under Enhancements as "Add option to keep only healthy ECS tasks". That describes a new optional feature, not a changed default or a removal, so an environment that does nothing would keep its current ECS behaviour, which supports kind "none". The excerpt doesn't state the option's default, so confidence is low. If it were on by default, the kind would be behavior-change instead.
